name: The system
short: One screen: every call caught, every job booked, and what still needs you.
long: The app a service business runs on, shown for six made-up businesses. Today puts the whole day on one board in the business’s own colour: every missed call caught, every booking made and every quote won since the morning, and the work it added up to. It replays the morning in a few seconds, and new enquiries and bookings keep landing while you watch. Switch business from the menu and it all reloads for that trade.
proves: The admin happens while you are on the tools.
features: A day’s feed built from every part: calls, bookings, quotes, reviews and reminders
Next jobs and what still needs you, one tap from each
Six made-up businesses from heating to physio, switched from the menu
The same screens on a phone, with a bar along the bottom
story: Most small firms run on a phone, a diary and memory. This is the one screen that replaces all three, built so a plumber can read it at a glance between jobs.
